definitions.name: currentApplication
definitions.notes: Describes GET /applications/@me on Discord API v10. Requires the application bot token. No Gateway intents, guild permissions or pagination are required. The response remains a partial typed projection. Verified 2026-10-16 against https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/application#get-current-application.

endpoint.rateLimit: The shared handwritten HTTP pipeline coordinates learned credential-global and route/resource limits, cancellation, deadlines and bounded retry budgets; sharding does not raise REST quotas.

definitions.name: currentUser
definitions.notes: Describes GET /users/@me on Discord API v10. Accepts bot or OAuth2 bearer authentication. OAuth2 requires identify; email controls email visibility and identify.premium controls premium type. No Gateway intents, guild permissions or pagination are required. The response remains a partial typed projection. Verified 2026-10-16 against https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/user#get-current-user.

endpoint.rateLimit: The shared handwritten HTTP pipeline coordinates learned credential-global and route/resource limits, cancellation, deadlines and bounded retry budgets; sharding does not raise REST quotas.

definitions.name: PremiumType
definitions.notes: Known Nitro subscription codes. Use RawValue<PremiumType> to retain future integral values without inventing a recognized case.

definitions.name: approximateGuildCount
definitions.notes: Approximate guild count as a native exact integer; no capacity claim follows.

definitions.name: approximateUserInstallCount
definitions.notes: Approximate user-install count as a native exact integer.

definitions.name: botPublic
definitions.notes: Whether users other than the owner may add the bot.

definitions.name: botRequireCodeGrant
definitions.notes: Whether bot authorization requires an OAuth2 code grant.

definitions.name: applicationDescription
definitions.notes: Application description text; no local content rules are imposed.

definitions.name: flags
definitions.notes: Legacy response flag bitset; unknown bits are retained and full future bits belong to flags_new.

definitions.name: flagsNew
definitions.notes: Response-only complete bitset string, preserving integers wider than native types.

definitions.name: guildID
definitions.notes: Associated guild snowflake, retained as an exact decimal-string identifier.

definitions.name: icon
definitions.notes: Application icon hash, explicitly null when unset.

definitions.name: id
definitions.notes: Application snowflake as an exact unsigned 64-bit decimal string.

definitions.name: interactionsEndpointURL
definitions.notes: Configured interactions URL or explicit null; decoding does not authorize an outbound destination.

definitions.name: name
definitions.notes: Application display name; diagnostics redact configuration values.

definitions.name: rpcOrigins
definitions.notes: RPC origin strings; these are retained without authorizing connections.

definitions.name: tags
definitions.notes: Application tags retained in server order; upstream editing limits are not enforced on responses.

definitions.name: team
definitions.notes: Required nullable team object; nested fields remain untyped and exact JSON numbers survive.

definitions.name: verifyKey
definitions.notes: Public interactions verification key; decoding does not validate or use it.

definitions.name: accentColor
definitions.notes: Banner accent color integer; fractional and exponent lexemes are rejected.

definitions.name: avatar
definitions.notes: Avatar hash, explicitly null when unset; no URL is fetched.

definitions.name: banner
definitions.notes: Optional banner hash; absent and explicit null remain distinct.

definitions.name: bot
definitions.notes: Whether the account belongs to an OAuth2 application.

definitions.name: discriminator
definitions.notes: Discord discriminator text, including the migrated-account value 0.

definitions.name: email
definitions.notes: Email address when visible under the email scope; diagnostics redact this value.

definitions.name: flags
definitions.notes: Exact user flag bitset; unknown bits remain available.

definitions.name: globalName
definitions.notes: Display name, explicitly null when unset.

definitions.name: id
definitions.notes: User snowflake as an exact unsigned 64-bit decimal string.

definitions.name: locale
definitions.notes: Selected locale string; future locale spellings remain unchanged.

definitions.name: mfaEnabled
definitions.notes: Whether multi-factor authentication is enabled.

definitions.name: premiumType
definitions.notes: Nitro subscription value; future integral values survive through RawValue.

definitions.name: publicFlags
definitions.notes: Exact public user flag bitset; unknown bits remain available.

definitions.name: system
definitions.notes: Whether Discord identifies this as an official system account.

definitions.name: username
definitions.notes: Account username; no local normalization or authorization inference is performed.

definitions.name: verified
definitions.notes: Email verification status when visible under the email scope.

definitions.name: Application
definitions.notes: A partial API v10 Application response projection, verified 2026-10-16 against https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/application. Required nullability differs from optional presence. Complete raw fields preserve future keys and numeric lexemes; diagnostics redact payloads. No general Codable round trip is promised. Owner, bot, team members, guild and installation configuration remain untyped.

definitions.name: User
definitions.notes: A partial API v10 User response projection, verified 2026-10-16 against https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/user. Required nullability differs from optional presence. Complete raw fields preserve future keys and numeric lexemes; diagnostics redact payloads. No general Codable round trip is promised. Avatar decorations, collectibles and primary guild remain untyped.

definitions.name: nitro
definitions.notes: Nitro subscription.

definitions.name: nitroBasic
definitions.notes: Nitro Basic subscription.

definitions.name: nitroClassic
definitions.notes: Nitro Classic subscription.

definitions.name: none
definitions.notes: No Nitro subscription.
